scheme_name: Karnataka Platform-Based Gig Workers (Social Security and Welfare) Act, 2025
eligibility_text: Platform-based gig workers in Karnataka across ride-hailing, food/grocery delivery, logistics, e-marketplace, healthcare, hospitality, travel and professional-service platforms. Registration is with the Karnataka Gig Workers Welfare Board.
benefits: Issues a portable Unique Worker ID; establishes a dedicated Social Security and Welfare Fund financed by a 1-5% aggregator transaction fee; the right to decline a work offer without penalty; a grievance-redressal mechanism. Specific benefit payouts from the Fund are being notified progressively by the Board.
source_note: Act notified May-Nov 2025. Verified Sep 2026 that the Board and Fund exist; check the Board's site for which specific cash benefits have been notified by demo day before quoting a payout amount.
